title: Mane Maratakkide
desc: After inheriting his ancestral home, Shravana fids out it's haunted. He hires a quirky team to tackle the issue, but their attempts to rid the house of spirits spiral into chaos.

title: Bahala Chennagide
desc: Two very good friends have to go through rough circumstances and face challenging situations that test the strength of their friendship.

title: Durgada Huli
desc: An archaeologist races against time to find a buried treasure after someone kidnaps his family and holds them hostage to make a trade.

title: Jenu Goodu
desc: Dharmanna's modest income supports the family until his brother Nagesha lands a plum job, but Nagesha's marriage to a wealthy bride upends their dynamics.

title: Ganapa
desc: When Tyru saves the underworld don Jayanna's life, he gets rechristened as Ganapa and becomes an important part of his gang. Problems arise when he and the gangster's son fall for the same girl.

title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Manikantana Mahime
desc: An ardent devotee of Lord Ayyappan narrates tales of various miracles performed by the Hindu deity where the Almighty tests the devotion of his followers.

title: Indradhanush
desc: Hari, a sculptor, is in a relationship with Yavanika and wishes to build a university. However, things take a turn when he realises that Yavanika has devious plans.

title: Anukoolakkobba Ganda
desc: Radha, a rich girl, falls in love with Raja, a mechanic. Complications arise when her father learns about their relationship and tries to separate the couple.

title: Mukunda Murari
desc: After an environmental disaster ruins his business and family, Mukunda, an atheist shop owner, sets out to sue God for his justice.

title: Ramakrishna
desc: Rama's father wants him to marry his friend's daughter, Lakshmi. In a case of mistaken identity, he ends up meeting Seetha instead of Lakshmi and falls in love with her.

title: Ravivarma
desc: Ravivarma is an artist with a special talent. However, his life turns upside down when he helps a police officer trace a notorious criminal through his artistic skills.
